scope: Hardened compact PoE (device side, 14.5 mm official RA023 pillars) and bare (computer side, host USB-C OTG) housing first articles on one plate; physical fit, cable seating, service cycles and powered cooling remain NOT RUN.
owner_direction: 2026-11-25: Review and fix the 3D printed housing for the Radxa ZERO 3E with and without the Ethernet PoE HAT, then print one PoE and one bare housing in a single 3D print on the ready printer.
revision_history: 2026-11-25 pre-print mechanical, electrical-safety, and printability audit of R7 identified 3 blockers (18 mm CAD gap vs shipped 14.5 mm RA023 pillars, r=4.3 mm lid seat recesses cutting through exterior corner walls, and roof/side vents exposing live 48-57 V corner mounts and bare 40-pin GPIO) plus 8 major defects.

2026-11-25 first R8 packet failed independent cold review (r8_cold_design_independent) on two real defects: (1) under Lacuna's frozen wall_loops=2 / 15% sparse infill profile, lid insert bosses had only 0.49-0.55 mm solid PLA outside the 4.6 mm RX-M3x5.7 insert OD across 86% of insert length; (2) bare-lid retention ribs collided with micro-HDMI (+0.30 mm) and worst-case 5.08 mm 40-pin GPIO (+0.16..0.40 mm) inside permitted XY board float.

2026-11-25 second R8 packet fixed both blockers and all 6 minor notes: expanded outer walls to 2.70 mm (5.00 mm corner inset) with three 60-deg x 0.12 mm open-top vertical perimeter-forcing seams (r=3.92..4.04 mm, z=4.6..12.6) yielding 4 solid concentric wall rings (0 sparse-infill layers, >=60.18 mm solid toolpath/layer in r=2.30..3.90 mm) across all 8 insert bosses; relocated bare_fins front ribs (>=4.30 mm from micro-HDMI, >=4.67 mm from USB3) and rear ribs (y=29.50..30.60 with +/-0.27 mm RJ45 cradle) passing 27 9-pose board-float checks; widened Z=3.8 square bridge to 3.4x3.4 mm; set bare_height=19.2 mm (exact 73 layers); expanded usb_window bottom to z=3.7 mm; cleared Mount 4 dia-8 reserve by 0.10 mm; passed independent cold review across all 7 required checks.

estimate.profile: OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, Flashforge Adventurer 5M 0.4, 0.20mm Standard, Flashforge Generic PLA, supports disabled

checks.method: check_joint.py sections the base at every 0.20 mm printed layer from Z 3.4 to Z 4.6 across all 4 axes: 2 bridge layers followed by 4 fused full layers with solid ring r=1.9..3.8 mm; flat seat contact between base post ring (OD 8.5 mm) and lid post face (OD 8.1 mm with r=3.92..4.04 perimeter seams) is >= 34.94 mm2 per post with 0.000 mm2 lid material below Z 4.6.

Exact G-code audit on all 8 base head shelves (Z 3.6 slot bridge, Z 3.8 3.4x3.4 mm square bridge, Z 4.0 corner bridges at 25 mm/s M106 S255, plus 3 zero-bridge solid layers Z 4.2..4.6) AND all 8 lid insert bosses (zero Sparse infill across all 31 insert layers inside r=2.30..3.90 mm, >= 60.18 mm solid concentric extrusion path/layer). Physical bridge and insert pull-out strength remain NOT RUN.

check_access.py: 138/138 PASS — 15x10 mm USB-C overmold sweeps, +1.55 mm top-latch RJ45 sweeps, nominal & expanded microSD allowances, full-height dia-8.0 conductive keepouts across all 3 printed parts (0.000 mm3 overlap), solid roof shrouding over all 4 live 48-57 V mounts and bare 40-pin GPIO (y>=22.0), continuous >=0.90 mm outer 2-loop corner skins on all 8 lid corners, >=1.6 mm nominal insert walls, 360-deg head-well walls, every vent open through all walls (1238.1 mm2 PoE / 742.2 mm2 bare), and 27 9-pose XY board-float collision checks (0.000 mm3 overlap against sbc-ref, worst-case 5.08 mm 2x20 GPIO, and PoE stack).

Lacuna slice and prepared-job preflight: 4 closed two-manifold BED_SUPPORTED bodies, exact STL-to-G-code layer heights (base 29, bare-lid 73, poe-lid 178 layers), supports disabled, 0 layer-support violations, exact mesh/job and 140x110 thumbnail binding.

limits: Nominal RA023 HAT spacing follows Radxa's shipped 4 x M2.5 x 14.5 mm copper pillars (hat_gap = 14.5 mm, 3.0 mm roof clearance). Accept measured facing PCB gap 14.2-14.8 mm; otherwise adjust hat_gap and reprint only the PoE lid.
Retention: SBC rests on six edge pads (Z 5.8) and lid ribs stop 0.4 mm above component-free top edges without clamping PCBs or loading the conductive pillars.
Acceptance after snugging: seam shadow gap 0.15-0.45 mm on every side; screw heads at or below floor; zero shelf, insert, or post movement.
Never connect both PoE and USB-C power simultaneously on a PoE-equipped board; leave bare box corner mounting holes empty and shrouded.
No digital check establishes printed tolerance, thread/insert pull-out strength, cable seating, service durability, or powered PLA thermal margin.
